summary: Design hybrid workflows, coordination rules and review indicators. Explore the five-day course and see how it fits your team’s needs.
lede: Hybrid work systems design examines how teams coordinate tasks, decisions and information across office, remote and asynchronous work. For team operations, HR and workplace professionals, the course develops practical skills in mapping work dependencies, setting RACI-based handoff rules, and reviewing workload and psychosocial risks using ISO 45003 guidance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape how hybrid teams allocate work, coordinate decisions and review delivery across locations. It suits intermediate learners with experience in team operations, people practices, workplace planning or related work-design responsibilities.
prerequisites: Intermediate level. Prior experience coordinating teams, reviewing work processes or supporting workplace and people practices is expected. No coding or programming is required. Exercises use spreadsheet calculations; advanced reporting concepts receive overview-level treatment rather than technical implementation.
